**Decision: CONTINUE.** Round 149 is V-1a, the first colour stage of the Studio visual refresh. I changed no store files; `git status` is still empty.

**Round 148 result**
- C passed every row at both viewports (browserVerified and realVerified true), with 0 bugs. Gate 148 published `b292ff4` on both remotes.
- I checked that the published commit matches A's final tree (11/11 files). So V-0.5c is done, **V-0 (English Studio text) is complete**, and C's round-148 layout capture is now the reference for V-1.
- Closed: GATE147-S1/S4 and GATE141-S2/S3.
- The new gate-148 suggestions:
  - S1 (doc 121 status) is scheduled in round 149.
  - S2/S3/S4 went to `deferred_low_polish`, which now has 215 entries.
- I ruled that C's layout judgment call on the video dock stands as a pass: the shifted x positions come from text anchored right or centred, not from a defect.
- The two Architecture notes (A's and the gate's) are recorded as signals, not tasks.

**Round 149 task (`current-task.md`)**
- **What A changes.**
  - One colour block appended to the end of `app/styles/app.css`, which is normally forbidden. The task gives a narrow grant for exactly this block: 18 colour tokens.
  - One attribute, `data-studio-theme="obsidian"`, on the StudioWorkspace root.
  - Three status lines in doc 121, a new test file (TH1–TH4, mutations m114–m118) and doc 122.
- **Scope of the colours.** The block also applies through `body:has(...)`, because the Export dialog and the marker menu render outside the Studio root. I tested this in a live browser by injecting the style, without touching the store. Side effect: on `/studio-lab`, the cookie banner and toasts turn warm too. Other Store pages are unchanged.
- **Two choices beyond the spec, both recorded:**
  - `dim` is `#928a7d` instead of `#8A8276`. The spec value only reaches 4.13:1 contrast on the selected library row; the new one reaches 4.60.
  - `outline-light` gets a warm value, because the lane grid lines use it.
- **What C checks:** the colour tokens (including both pop-ups), that nothing moves by more than 1 px, contrast on the elements that failed before, unchanged Store pages against a baseline I captured, whether states that only differed by teal vs orange can still be told apart, plus a short behaviour smoke test and the sign-in protection check.

**Why V-1 is split in two.** The approved border colours can't give text fields the required 3:1 boundary contrast. That fix needs class changes in 4 more components, so it is V-1b, the next round. Until then, field borders get fainter in the V-1a publication (about 1.15:1, down from 1.51); the task says so plainly.

**Architecture checkpoint.** I sent root `b-round-148-checkpoint-request.md` with three questions; it replaces the older open request. It doesn't block V-1.

**Other notes**
- The advisor was available and used twice. After the second call I made the contrast pass/fail rule explicit and added a "Low caused by this round → bounded fix-up" outcome to the task.
- I also checked that no e2e test pins Studio colours.
- No regression round is due until 2026-10-27. The two decision files in `user-review/` (`ableton-decisions.md`, `design-ux-decisions.md`) are still absent.

**Remaining after V-1a:** V-1b, V-2, V-3, M1/M3/M4, T12-ADVANCED, the deferred-Low polish pass, backend-only evidence, the Tech Lead manual checks, items waiting on the user, and the final regression.
